items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Ralph Collins is here interviewing Mr. Thomas here.

ctx.x: This is over at Joe Thomas' home at St. Anne, right near Galvez. And the date is September 29, 1960. This is Bill Russell and Ralph Collins is here interviewing Mr. Thomas here. If you could give us your name, your full name to start.
